We need subject_type and object_type.

Define types: iPhone 8 is a smartphone (object_type: smartphone). Apple Inc. is a company (organization). Steve Jobs Theater is a building (venue). Apple Park campus is a campus (location). Dates are date.

Similarly for iPhone 8 Plus (maybe combine but separate entries). Could also combine but separate.

6. iPhone 8, relation: announced on, object: 12 September 2017, qualifiers [], subject_type product, object_type date.

8. iPhone 8, relation: announced at, object: Steve Jobs Theater, qualifiers [], subject_type product, object_type building.

Actually "succeeded" means iPhone 8 succeeded iPhone 7. So subject iPhone 8, relation: succeeded, object: iPhone 7. Similarly for iPhone 8 Plus succeeded iPhone 7 Plus.
